page.overview:
Who is Todd Williams?

Amber Bennett (love interest) William Clockwell

Todd Williams was a bully attending Reginald Vel Johnson High School notable for bullying Mark Grayson during his high school years.

Not much is known about Todd's past other than his father dying at some point.

Todd believed that Amber is crazy in love with him and that Marcy told him. Being refused by Amber, he questioned her if she is a lesbian. Mark tries to stand up for her but gets beaten up until Amber kicks Todd in the groin.
